**Finding: compliant** (RENEWAL — Auto-renewal and non-renewal notice window)

- **What the document does:** Maintenance is granted for a "renewable one-year term" (§10, p0065). There is no auto-renewal language, no non-renewal notice window, and no multi-year renewal term anywhere in the agreement — a document-wide search for "renew" returns only that single reference.
- **Exit:** The licence continues perpetually while fees are paid (§17(a)) and Sparkling may terminate at any time on 90 days' written notice (§17(b)), so there is no renewal lock-in or notice-window trap.
- **Pricing:** Fees are set by the Fee Schedule (§11) and Garman has no unilateral increase/escalation right anywhere in the document, so uncapped renewal repricing is not available to it; any change would need a written amendment.
- **Noted, not redlined:** no express CPI/3% uplift cap and no 60-day vendor renewal reminder — preferred-only sub-elements that the playbook treats as rationale notes rather than deviations.

No redline proposed.
